scope: Original-label regional-feature sensitivity and prespecified grouping stress tests; no OMOP or time-isolated inference
regional_field_source: AST literal REGIONAL_FIELDS in frozen prepare_china.py; all five fields selected by exact name, never importance or outcome
primary_design: Reuse all five frozen original patient-role arrays, parameters, raw NaN inputs, labels and full-outer-train 50:50 XGBoost/RandomForest ensemble. Select XGBoost rounds separately using only saved inner-fit/inner-stop roles. Numeric NaN values are zero-filled only after feature selection, preserving the original Chinese strategy; true observed zero is not classified as missing.

SCH.name: stored_city_holdout
SCH.eligibility: All original records have exactly one complete nonplaceholder province/city pair after whitespace trimming

WHU.name: numeric_signature_holdout
WHU.eligibility: All frozen patients; groups are exact five-column float32 patient-mean numeric regional signatures including missingness, NOT verified geographic units

stress_split: One deterministic StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), fixed after assignment/class-count feasibility audit and before any performance analysis. No seed search. All 104 inputs. Outer-test groups excluded from all training. Original patient-stratified calibration/inner role proportions and seeds are used inside outer-training only; inner roles are not city/signature-disjoint. Calibration role joins full refit; no new calibration is fitted.
stress_comparator: Original patient-isolated primary predictions restricted to exactly the same eligible patients; paired difference changes partition and sometimes eligible training cohort, not an isolated causal effect of geographic leakage
bootstrap_unit: patient; identical multinomial multiplicities for all models in each comparison; conditional fixed-OOF percentile 95% intervals, no refitting, no multiplicity correction
stress_secondary_uncertainty: Also provide 2000 outer-group-cluster bootstrap intervals for stress versus restricted original predictions, acknowledging potential within-city/signature correlation. Signatures remain non-geographic and 5-fold model selection uncertainty is not captured.
not_performed: External verification of original address/administrative/year mapping
Causal attribution of feature-set or split differences
